svg.title: 391 repositories in orbit
svg.desc: A rotating 3D sphere with one point for each of 391 public repositories, sized by stars and colored by section. Robinhood Chain: 22; x402 payments and agent commerce: 83; MCP servers for AI agents: 56; 3D AI agents and avatars: 59; Solana and pump.fun tooling: 24; DeFi mechanisms and Uniswap v4 hooks: 46; On-chain experiments and collectibles: 73; Developer tools and everything else: 28.
svg.text: One point per public repo. Size is stars, color is the section.
